summary: The operating-system credential store each port uses for the service API key. Both ports read and write the same item on every platform, so a login with either one works for both. There is no plaintext fallback: without a store, set the credential variable.

requires: a running Secret Service provider (for example GNOME Keyring or KeePassXC)
rustRequires: secret-tool, from the distribution's libsecret tools package (libsecret-tools on Debian and Ubuntu, libsecret on Arch and Fedora)

windows.reason: neither port uses the Windows Credential Manager; set the credential variable
